run_experiments_ogre: run PHYRE-B cross template experiments on PHYRE-Tools using the ogre agent with 10 random seeds
generate_tasks: generate a sequence of training tasks for ball cross template and ball phyre to tools evaluation setups
arg_generator_tools: generate experiment arguments for a given seed using the ball cross template evaluation setup
main_submit_jobs: submit training jobs to an executor and wait for all jobs to complete with logging
main_cli: run the experiment runner from the command line with debug logging and a dummy executor
